workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. The only time that works for them from your list is Thursday at 14:30. Please go ahead and book the 30-minute meeting for that time. Once it's booked, I'll send the confirmation email.

workspace.text: Thanks, Brad. I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30. It's now in the system. Can you please send the confirmation email?

emails.body:
Dear Partners,

The meeting is scheduled for next Thursday, November 19, at 14:30 Eastern time.

Brad
